max_words_rationale: Lowered to 320 for Plato (Marcus stays 380, Darwin 340). At 380 one chunk (Phaedo 58–59, 372 words) measured 552 bge-small tokens. The densest chunks, at up to 1.48 tokens per word, are rapid labelled exchanges, where each normalised speaker label is one word but several model tokens; 320 leaves about 7% headroom at that density. Every chunk is checked to be at most 512 model tokens before embedding.
split_strategy: Recursively choose the paragraph boundary closest to half the words; if none, the nearest sentence boundary; if none, the nearest point just after a semicolon followed by whitespace. Preserve order and paragraph breaks. Fail if a span with no paragraph, sentence or semicolon boundary exceeds max_words. No overlap. A sentence boundary following a listed abbreviation ending in a full stop is excluded (case-sensitive). A sentence boundary after a token consisting of one or more uppercase initials, each followed by a full stop, is excluded.
